question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Calculate the median using PERCENTILE_CONT or NTILE
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        season,
        SUM(goals) as total_goals
    FROM (
        SELECT home_team as team_name, season, home_team_goal as goals FROM match_view WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT away_team as team_name, season, away_team_goal as goals FROM match_view WHERE away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY team_name, season
),
team_max_season_goals AS (
    SELECT team_name, MAX(total_goals) as max_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_name
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY max_season_goals) as median_max_season_goals
FROM team_max_season_goals
